assertions.text: Classifies the finding as belonging to round 1
Routes the finding to the Fix path, not the Issue or Decline path
States that verification is a hard precondition before any reply/resolve action -- never claims a reply or resolve happens on the strength of a pushed commit alone
Describes committing via Skill(git-kit:commit), not a raw `git commit`
The drafted reply cites both the fixing commit SHA and a one-line summary of what verification confirmed
States the thread is resolved only after the reply, and only because verification actually passed
